decision: Permit the existing icon prop to be a decorative start/end slot only for Button, with end as its default. No other component gains trailing-icon permission.

evidence.channel: Interactive owner choice forwarded in the parent task
evidence.question: ¿Aprobás una excepción documentada de la convención leading-icon solo para Button: permitir icono decorativo al inicio o al final, con final por defecto, sin ampliar el permiso para otros componentes ni alterar los recibos históricos?
evidence.interpretation: Assistant record of forwarded explicit owner approval, not native, signed, independent or per-payload serialized review. Hashes bind recorded content, not proof of consent.

limits: Only Button icon with iconPosition start/end, default end; decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
All other components retain the previous leading-icon restrictions. Icon-only, interactive and sole-carrier-of-meaning icons remain excluded.
The registry exceptions array only represents alternative prop names; the same-name semantic exception is encoded through a bounded semantic amendment, not an alternate name or a schema change.
Historical receipts and their content hashes remain immutable. Parent implementation-plan approval is separate from full-contract and naming approval.

before.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology.
before.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text.
before.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning.

after.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default.
after.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end.
after.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. The trailing-icon exclusion has one exception: Button with iconPosition; no other component gains trailing-icon permission.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Button only; no other component gains trailing-icon permission. The canonical icon name, aliases, exceptions, status and existing source usages are unchanged by this amendment.

convention.name: icon
